user.description: Pick a device tracker to expose as a binary sensor. The original device tracker will be hidden. The binary sensor is on when the tracker reports 'home' and off otherwise.

source_entity_missing.title: Wrapped device tracker for {title} is missing
source_entity_missing.description:
The Device Tracker as Binary Sensor helper **{title}** wraps `{entity_id}`, which no longer exists in the entity registry, so the helper cannot be set up.

To fix this, go to **Settings → Devices & Services → Helpers**, open the helper and either choose **Reconfigure** to wrap a different device tracker, or **Delete** it.
